protocol.model: the final model of P13b part 2: its level, loss arm and penalty weight, P13a's knots and layout constants

rules.R1: a configuration without one or both terms is eligible when it scores more than SESOI above the full model, with the 95 percent paired interval above 0
rules.R2: the one-standard-error rule over the full model and the eligible configurations, ordered from the most terms to the fewest (a tie in terms by the higher score)
rules.R3: the artist terms alone are reported, not chosen, and flagged when they score more than SESOI above the chosen configuration with the interval above 0

protocol.selection: full-catalog NDCG@100 of the val_last and val_first picks of the selection listeners
protocol.start: each refit starts from the final model's parameters of its own terms

references: ALS, phase D winner (256 factors, nu 0)
